passages.text: After these events, the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision: “Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Abram in a vision.
This happened after these events.
The LORD said, “Do not be afraid, Abram.
I am your shield.
I am your very great reward.”
passages.original: אַחַ֣ר׀ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה הָיָ֤ה דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ אַבְרָ֔ם בַּֽמַּחֲזֶ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אַל־ תִּירָ֣א אַבְרָ֗ם אָנֹכִי֙ מָגֵ֣ן לָ֔ךְ שְׂכָרְךָ֖ הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: But Abram replied, “O Lord GOD, what can You give me, since I remain childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?”
passages.sermon:
Abram spoke to the Lord God.
Abram said, “O Lord God, what will You give me?
I have no children.
I am still childless.
Eliezer is from Damascus.
Eliezer is the heir of my house.
Eliezer will inherit from me.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְרָ֗ם אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהוִה֙ מַה־ תִּתֶּן־ לִ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עֲרִירִ֑י וּבֶן־ מֶ֣שֶׁק בֵּיתִ֔י ה֖וּא דַּמֶּ֥שֶׂק אֱלִיעֶֽזֶר׃

passages.text: Abram continued, “Behold, You have given me no offspring, so a servant in my household will be my heir.”
passages.sermon: Abram spoke to the LORD.\r\nAbram said, “You have not given me any children.”\r\nA servant in my household will inherit from me.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְרָ֔ם הֵ֣ן לִ֔י לֹ֥א נָתַ֖תָּה זָ֑רַע וְהִנֵּ֥ה בֶן־ בֵּיתִ֖י יוֹרֵ֥שׁ אֹתִֽי׃

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Abram, saying, “This one will not be your heir, but one who comes from your own body will be your heir.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Abram.
The LORD said, “This man will not be your heir.
Your heir will come from your own body.
Your own child will inherit from you.”
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֤ה אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א יִֽירָשְׁךָ֖ זֶ֑ה כִּי־ אִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵצֵ֣א מִמֵּעֶ֔יךָ ה֖וּא יִֽירָשֶֽׁךָ׃

passages.text: And the LORD took him outside and said, “Now look to the heavens and count the stars, if you are able.” Then He told him, “So shall your offspring be.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Abram.
The LORD took Abram outside.
The LORD said, "Look up at the sky."
The LORD said, "Count the stars, if you can count them."
The LORD said, "Your descendants will be as many as the stars."
passages.original: וַיּוֹצֵ֨א אֹת֜וֹ הַח֗וּצָה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַבֶּט־ נָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֗יְמָה וּסְפֹר֙ הַכּ֣וֹכָבִ֔ים אִם־ תּוּכַ֖ל לִסְפֹּ֣ר אֹתָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ כֹּ֥ה יִהְיֶ֖ה זַרְעֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Abram believed the LORD, and it was credited to him as righteousness.
passages.sermon: Abram trusted the LORD.\r\nThe LORD saw Abram’s faith.\r\nThe LORD counted Abram’s faith as righteousness.

passages.text: The LORD also told him, “I am the LORD, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to possess.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Abram.
The LORD identified Himself.
The LORD said, “I am the LORD.”
The LORD reminded Abram of His actions.
The LORD said, “I brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans.”
The LORD stated His purpose.
The LORD said, “I brought you out to give you this land.”
The LORD said, “You will possess this land.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑יו אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵאתִ֙יךָ֙ מֵא֣וּר כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים לָ֧תֶת לְךָ֛ אֶת־ הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: But Abram replied, “Lord GOD, how can I know that I will possess it?”
passages.sermon:
Abram spoke to the LORD.
Abram said, “Lord GOD, how can I know this?”
Abram asked how he would know that he would possess the land.
Abram wanted assurance from God.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהוִ֔ה בַּמָּ֥ה אֵדַ֖ע כִּ֥י אִֽירָשֶֽׁנָּה׃

passages.text: And the LORD said to him, “Bring Me a heifer, a goat, and a ram, each three years old, along with a turtledove and a young pigeon.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Abram.
The LORD is God.
The LORD told Abram what to do.
The LORD said, “Bring Me a heifer that is three years old.
Bring Me a goat that is three years old.
Bring Me a ram that is three years old.
Bring Me a turtledove.
Bring Me a young pigeon.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו קְחָ֥ה לִי֙ עֶגְלָ֣ה מְשֻׁלֶּ֔שֶׁת וְעֵ֥ז מְשֻׁלֶּ֖שֶׁת וְאַ֣יִל מְשֻׁלָּ֑שׁ וְתֹ֖ר וְגוֹזָֽל׃

passages.text: So Abram brought all these to Him, split each of them down the middle, and laid the halves opposite each other. The birds, however, he did not cut in half.
passages.sermon:
Abram obeyed God.
He brought all the animals to God.
He split each animal down the middle.
He placed each half opposite the other half.
He did not cut the birds in half.
passages.original: וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ ל֣וֹ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵ֗לֶּה וַיְבַתֵּ֤ר אֹתָם֙ בַּתָּ֔וֶךְ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אִישׁ־ בִּתְר֖וֹ לִקְרַ֣את רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְאֶת־ הַצִפֹּ֖ר לֹ֥א בָתָֽר׃

passages.text: And the birds of prey descended on the carcasses, but Abram drove them away.
passages.sermon: Abram was present with animal carcasses.\r\nBirds of prey came down onto the carcasses.\r\nAbram drove the birds of prey away.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֥רֶד הָעַ֖יִט עַל־ הַפְּגָרִ֑ים וַיַּשֵּׁ֥ב אֹתָ֖ם אַבְרָֽם׃

passages.text: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and suddenly great terror and darkness overwhelmed him.
passages.sermon:
Abram was a man chosen by God.
The sun began to set.
Abram fell into a deep sleep.
A great terror came upon Abram.
Darkness overwhelmed him.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֤י הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ לָב֔וֹא וְתַרְדֵּמָ֖ה נָפְלָ֣ה עַל־ אַבְרָ֑ם וְהִנֵּ֥ה אֵימָ֛ה חֲשֵׁכָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה נֹפֶ֥לֶת עָלָֽיו׃

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Abram, “Know for certain that your descendants will be strangers in a land that is not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Abram.
The LORD said, “Know this for certain.
Your descendants will live as strangers.
They will be in a land that does not belong to them.
People in that land will enslave your descendants.
People in that land will mistreat your descendants.
This will last four hundred years.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְאַבְרָ֗ם יָדֹ֨עַ תֵּדַ֜ע כִּי־ גֵ֣ר׀ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְעֲךָ֗ בְּאֶ֙רֶץ֙ לֹ֣א לָהֶ֔ם וַעֲבָד֖וּם וְעִנּ֣וּ אֹתָ֑ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: But I will judge the nation they serve as slaves, and afterward they will depart with many possessions.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abram.
God said that Abram’s descendants would serve another nation as slaves.
God said, “I will judge the nation that enslaves them.”
After I judge that nation, your descendants will leave.
They will leave with many possessions.
passages.original: וְגַ֧ם אֶת־ הַגּ֛וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲבֹ֖דוּ דָּ֣ן אָנֹ֑כִי וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֥ן יֵצְא֖וּ בִּרְכֻ֥שׁ גָּדֽוֹל׃

passages.text: You, however, will go to your fathers in peace and be buried at a ripe old age.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abram.
God promised Abram a peaceful end.
Abram would die in peace.
Abram would join his ancestors.
Abram would be buried.
Abram would live to a good old age.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֛ה תָּב֥וֹא אֶל־ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ בְּשָׁל֑וֹם תִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּשֵׂיבָ֥ה טוֹבָֽה׃

passages.text: In the fourth generation your descendants will return here, for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet complete.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abram.
God promised Abram that his descendants would return to this land.
They would return in the fourth generation.
The Amorites lived in this land.
The Amorites had not finished their iniquity yet.
God would wait until the Amorites’ iniquity was complete.
Then Abram’s descendants would come back to this land.
passages.original: וְד֥וֹר רְבִיעִ֖י יָשׁ֣וּבוּ הֵ֑נָּה כִּ֧י לֹא־ שָׁלֵ֛ם עֲוֺ֥ן הָאֱמֹרִ֖י עַד־ הֵֽנָּה׃

passages.text: When the sun had set and darkness had fallen, behold, a smoking firepot and a flaming torch appeared and passed between the halves of the carcasses.
passages.sermon:
The sun set.
Darkness fell.
A smoking firepot appeared.
A flaming torch appeared.
The smoking firepot and the flaming torch passed between the halves of the carcasses.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֤י הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ בָּ֔אָה וַעֲלָטָ֖ה הָיָ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה תַנּ֤וּר עָשָׁן֙ וְלַפִּ֣יד אֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָבַ֔ר בֵּ֖ין הַגְּזָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, “To your descendants I have given this land—from the river of Egypt to the great River Euphrates— the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites, Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites, Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites, and Jebusites.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
Abram is a man chosen by God.
On that day, the LORD made a covenant with Abram.
The LORD spoke to Abram.
The LORD said, “I have given this land to your descendants.”
The land stretches from the river of Egypt to the great river, the Euphrates.
This land includes the territory of the Kenites.
It includes the Kenizzites.
It includes the Kadmonites.
It includes the Hittites.
It includes the Perizzites.
It includes the Rephaites.
It includes the Amorites.
It includes the Canaanites.
It includes the Girgashites.
It includes the Jebusites.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא כָּרַ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ אַבְרָ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית לֵאמֹ֑ר לְזַרְעֲךָ֗ נָתַ֙תִּי֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את מִנְּהַ֣ר מִצְרַ֔יִם עַד־ הַנָּהָ֥ר הַגָּדֹ֖ל נְהַר־ פְּרָֽת׃ אֶת־ הַקֵּינִי֙ וְאֶת־ הַקְּנִזִּ֔י וְאֵ֖ת הַקַּדְמֹנִֽי׃ וְאֶת־ הַחִתִּ֥י וְאֶת־ הַפְּרִזִּ֖י וְאֶת־ הָרְפָאִֽים׃ וְאֶת־ הָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְאֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י וְאֶת־ הַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֖י וְאֶת־ הַיְבוּסִֽי׃ס
